purpose: Single machine-readable contract for closing architecture gaps across the three Flutter roots, shared contracts, adapters, runtime, UI, assurance and release lifecycle.

dimension_controls.contract: shared capability contracts plus this completeness contract
dimension_controls.ownership: canonical owner is declared per capability before implementation is promoted
dimension_controls.implementation: implementation remains in the owning subsystem; no shadow implementation is accepted
dimension_controls.ui_surface: UI consumes capability/state contracts and does not become an authority boundary
dimension_controls.api_surface: API endpoints are mapped to an adapter and capability or explicitly marked compatibility-only
dimension_controls.state: view, domain and trust state have distinct ownership and explicit lifecycle
dimension_controls.navigation: navigation is shell-owned and declarative; features do not own global navigation
dimension_controls.error_recovery: errors have stable categories, recoverability and evidence semantics
dimension_controls.security_authority: identity, policy and human approval remain outside presentation widgets
dimension_controls.audit_observability: correlation, audit, health and evidence share stable identifiers
dimension_controls.offline_recovery: offline work is queued, replayed and reconciled without duplicate mutation
dimension_controls.idempotency_concurrency: mutations expose replay keys and concurrent work has explicit ownership semantics
dimension_controls.schema_versioning: schema/event/contract changes declare compatibility and migration policy
dimension_controls.platform_parity: platform runners preserve application contracts while retaining platform-specific identity
dimension_controls.design_system: visual tokens, components and interaction rules have one declared source of truth
dimension_controls.accessibility: semantic labels, focus, contrast, reduced motion and keyboard/screen-reader paths are testable
dimension_controls.performance: startup, frame, memory and network budgets are explicit and measurable
dimension_controls.feature_flags: flags have owner, default, scope, expiry and removal/migration policy
dimension_controls.artifact_provenance: build/release artifacts bind to exact source and verification evidence
dimension_controls.migration: upgrades define preflight, compatibility, migration, rollback and postflight checks
dimension_controls.retirement: a root or capability is retired only after parity, dependency, evidence and rollback gates close
